packageRules.description: Modules patches/apply.sh patches or copies by version. A bump has to refresh the patch, so it opens on its own, and only on dashboard approval. A security update still opens, on its own (see vulnerabilityAlerts above, which repeats this list), and the vendor-pin label keeps the preset from labeling it automerge.
prBodyNotes: This module is also copied into `vendor/` at a pinned version by `patches/apply.sh`, or patched there. Move that pin, and refresh any patch, with this update, or the build keeps the old code. A security update to it is therefore never labeled `automerge`.
